name: Locust Marching Bands
desc: Thousands of marchers, each only steering toward whoever is within a body-length of it — crowd them past the threshold and order condenses out of the gas as a solitary band, a hard dense front that sweeps the frame and evaporates back into shimmering grain, drawn only ever as density, never as insects.

density.doc: crowding — the actual Vicsek control parameter; low = a thin disordered gas, high = a packed field that condenses into hard sweeping bands

scale.doc: grain of the field (higher = coarser, chunkier density)

noise.doc: how badly each individual mis-hears its neighbours — the other side of the order-disorder transition; low = a single coherent flock, high = boiling gas

style.doc: aesthetic — warm photographic plate of the band / false-colour with hue keyed to marching direction / ink density on toned paper / ironbow crowding map / abstracted order-parameter field where density is dissolved and only local alignment is drawn

act.doc: multi-minute program — steady near-critical marching / a full sweep of the order-disorder transition every ~3 min / a hard turning wind that keeps shoving the swarm onto a new course

seed.doc: seeds the sowing of the swarm
